paragraphs.title: Persia, Greece, and the Writing of Truth

easy.explanation: He says, “Now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia.”

easy.explanation: Michael is identified as the one who holds with the figure in these things.

answers: That which is noted in the scripture of truth
The names of all the people of Persia
The number of people beside the river
medium.explanation: He promises to show Daniel what is noted in the scripture of truth.

answers: Michael is the prince associated with Daniel’s people
Michael is the king of Persia
Michael was one of the men with Daniel
